stock.description: Headquartered in Dalian, People's Republic of China, Neutech Group Limited, established in 2000, operates as an investment holding company. The firm, which rebranded from Neusoft Education Technology Co. Limited in January 2025, primarily delivers digital talent education services across the PRC. Its operations are broadly divided into an Education Business segment and a Healthcare and Wellness Business segment. The Education division provides extensive services, encompassing formal higher education via universities that offer bachelor's and junior college degrees, as well as transfer programs, in addition to educational resources, apprenticeship schemes, and lifelong learning opportunities. Concurrently, the Healthcare and Wellness arm focuses on delivering medical and wellness solutions. Beyond these core areas, the company also engages in various other ventures, including publishing, software development, and property management, alongside offering training, medical, healthcare, and hotel services, as well as medical business and hospital management expertise. Neutech also distributes medical devices.
